title: Let the Muscles Go
description: A quick pass through the body, softening what worked hardest.

steps.text: Lie down if you can, or sit. Let the floor take your weight.
Bring your attention to the legs. Feel the warmth of the work in them. Now let them go heavy.
The hips and the lower back. Breathe into them, and soften.
The arms and the shoulders. Let them drop, as if someone just lifted a weight off them.
The hands, the jaw, the face. Unclench whatever is still holding on.
Look for any place that is still tight. Breathe toward it, and let the breath out loosen it.
Feel the whole body resting. The work is done.
